metadata.source: Lega Pallavolo Serie A — official SuperLega results, calendar and final standings
metadata.coverage: Complete 2023/24 SuperLega regular season: 12 teams, 132 final matches, 22 official rounds, 22 games per team, 22 October 2023–3 March 2024. Actual final set scores and every set’s rally points from official results pages. Official local kickoff dates and times converted from Europe/Rome to UTC. Playoffs, Coppa Italia, Supercoppa and player statistics excluded. All final points, wins, losses, sets and rally-point totals checked against the official final table.

metricDefinitions.points: 3–0/3–1: winner 3 league points, loser 0. 3–2: winner 2, loser 1.
metricDefinitions.difference: Sets won − sets lost. Match scores and standings for/against count sets; actual rally points are retained in each match’s sets array.
metricDefinitions.ranking: League points, wins, then set quotient (sets won ÷ sets lost); unresolved ties use stable team ID. The final 2023/24 table has no tied league-points totals. Official further tie-breaks use rally-point quotient.
metricDefinitions.series: Cumulative league points after each official regular-season round. Rescheduled matches remain in their assigned round; a round is not a calendar date.
metricDefinitions.winPct: Wins ÷ played × 100; zero before any match is played.
metricDefinitions.form: Latest five final results by actual kickoff date, oldest → newest. W = win, L = loss.
metricDefinitions.splits: Home/away aggregates use the official home and away assignments.
metricDefinitions.missing: Unavailable statistics remain absent. No set scores, results, dates or advanced statistics are estimated.
metricDefinitions.collection: One-time public official HTML collection; Anno=2023, IdCampionato=911, IdFase=1/2 and the 22 calendar-provided IdGiornata values. Original response text and SHA-256/retrieval-time sidecars are cached under data/raw/volleyball-real; normal reruns use the cache.
